title: Juicy Roasted French Beef Cutlet Souffle
description: A roasted, gooey French dish featuring beef cutlet, kombu-cold-extract, and dash-friendly flavors in a souffle form, perfect for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef cutlet with dash-friendly seasoning and let it rest for 10 minutes.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat and sear the beef cutlet until browned on both sides.
Transfer the beef cutlet to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the milk, flour, and a pinch of salt, and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until melted.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, kombu-cold-extract, and a pinch of black pepper.
Add the cooked beef cutlet to the bowl and stir until the eggs are fully incorporated.
Pour the egg mixture into a buttered souffle dish and bake in the oven for 25 minutes.
Serve the souffle hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
